subject: Emergency quota uplift + blended runway plan for BrightCart launch
messages:
From: Alicia Moore <alicia@brightcart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: capacity runway for 72-hour promotion

Hi Sean,

We're launching a site-wide promotion starting tomorrow and our QA traffic model just spiked — looks like we need a temporary uplift for the next 72 hours. Can Redwood temporarily raise our per-minute quota and provide a short-term blended overage rate? Procurement asked for an invoice cushion (we prefer a single line item to tie to our launch budget).

I attached our traffic forecast and a brief note from the ops team. Key asks:
- Immediate increase to burst quota by ~3x for next 3 days (start: 2026-09-28 08:00 PT)
- Blended overage rate capped at a single hourly rate so we can commit to internal PO
- Short invoice/cost cap and reconciliation path after the event

Can you confirm availability and an estimated cost? If needed, procurement (procurement@brightcart.com) can sign a short amendment or an escrowed credit agreement.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Moore
Head of Performance, BrightCart

Attachments: BrightCart_MLP_traffic_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moore <alicia@brightcart.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: capacity runway for 72-hour promotion

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the forecast. We can support an immediate temporary uplift but want to align on two operational points to make sure we don't create surprises for either side:

1) Throughput path: We can open a short-lived burst pool that multiplies your committed QPS by 3 for a 72-hour window. That requires a quick acceptance of an amendment for the uplift window.

2) Billing path: We propose a blended overage rate for the uplift window (flat per-token/hour band) plus a reconciliation true-up after the event. Alternatively, we can accept an escrowed credit pre-funded by procurement and reconcile after.

I looped in Priyom (sales ops) and Lauren (billing) to provide the exact rate and draft amendment. If procurement can sign an amendment or pre-authorize a credit by EOD today we can flip the switch for 08:00 PT tomorrow.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Lauren: quick blended-rate quote + invoice format that matches BrightCart PO needs
- Priyom: prepare a 72-hour amendment document, with rollback policy and usage cap
- Alicia: confirm final uplift start time and whether procurement will pre-authorize funds

I will standby for Lauren/Priyom.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Urgent: capacity runway for 72-hour promotion

Team — quick internal thread to align on pricing/terms. Alicia is asking for a 72-hour 3x uplift starting tomorrow 08:00 PT. They want a single-line invoice/cost cap and a predictable blended rate for internal approvals. Notes and suggestions: 

- Pricing: Recommend a temporary blended overage rate = (committed unit rate * 1.6) capped hourly. This is slightly higher than paygo but gives procurement predictability. We can offer a differential discount if they prepay an escrow.
- Billing construct: One invoice line for the uplift window (hours * capped rate). Reconcile actual usage post-window and issue adjustment credit/debit on next invoice.
- Risk controls: Auto-rollback to committed QPS at window end, plus a hard token limit to prevent runaway charges.
- SLA/Amendment: Draft a 1-page amendment with start/end times, cap, rollback behavior, and a clause allowing DocuSign acceptance by procurement.

Karthik — can you confirm the hard token limit we should set based on their forecast (see attachment)? Lauren — can you produce the invoice stub (single-line) and the DocuSign-ready amendment PDF? I can then send to Alicia and procurement for signature.

Priyom
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moore <alicia@brightcart.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2026-09-27T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: capacity runway for 72-hour promotion — proposed uplift & billing path

Alicia —

Appended below is a concise proposal from Redwood based on your forecast. If procurement can sign the attached 1-pg amendment (DocuSign link below) or confirm pre-authorization of an escrow by 18:00 PT today, we will enable the 72-hour uplift at 08:00 PT tomorrow.

Summary proposal (72-hour uplift for BrightCart)
- Uplift: 3x committed QPS for 72 hours (start: 2026-09-28T08:00:00 PT; end: 2026-10-01T08:00:00 PT)
- Billing: Blended overage capped rate = $0.00042 per token equivalent (single-line invoice per hour).
- Cap & rollback: Hard token cap set to forecast + 20% headroom. Auto-rollback to committed levels at end of window.
- Reconciliation: Final usage reconciled within 7 business days; any over/under billed amount will be adjusted as a credit/debit on next invoice.
- Acceptance: DocuSign amendment link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/ABCDEF123456

Attachments: SLA-amendment-draft.pdf (1-page amendment)

Lauren — invoice stub and payment instructions are attached. Priyom — please confirm token cap number when you see Alicia's forecast. Karthik — please confirm there are no infra blocking constraints for a 3x uplift on our side.

Alicia — if that works, procurement can sign via DocuSign and we'll enable the uplift immediately afterwards. If you prefer an escrow path instead I can have Lauren share wiring instructions.

Thanks,
—Sean
